tools_used: WebFetch (supremecourt.gov docket page and reply brief PDF)
helpful: Provisioned petition, BIO and QP text with documents.json metadata
Segment base rate by salience band table with bracketed reached rates
Relist-count and CVSG cuts on the paid scored segment
gaps: The cert-stage reply brief was on the docket before the snapshot but not provisioned; I had to fetch and extract it myself
fedcourts query has no subject filter usable on SCOTUS rows, so it cannot surface copyright or extraterritoriality priors; the one query I ran returned generic recent grants
No per-amicus-count cut in the statpack, though cert-stage amicus volume is a strong grant correlate
A statpack cut for first-circuit-to-decide (no split) petitions with elite counsel would help calibrate the main uncertainty here
notes: The CourtListener MCP server was reachable and confirmed the Fifth Circuit opinion is published. WebFetch returned the reply PDF as binary; I extracted its text locally with pypdf. Roughly five retrieval calls in total, well under budget.
